findings.summary: The page uses a fixed dark palette but does not expose or respond to the user’s colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition probe reports colorScheme “normal”, no prefers-color-scheme CSS, and the normal and dark captures are materially identical.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so browser chrome and surfaces follow the user preference.

findings.summary: Motion is not reduced when the user requests less motion.
findings.evidence: The video-detail probe found two running 1500 ms animations, while the CSS probe found no prefers-reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce branch that removes non-essential animation and auto-advance.

findings.summary: The age gate becomes unusable under increased-contrast preference.
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot hides the white heading, explanatory copy, and both age decision controls, leaving only orange links visible.
findings.suggestedFix: Test the gate in forced/high-contrast modes and preserve text and control boundaries with system colors and forced-color-adjust only where necessary.

findings.summary: The primary age-gate state change is an abrupt custom swap rather than a view transition.
findings.evidence: The entry-flow video shows the gate disappearing and content/cookie state replacing it; the CSS probe found no view-transition usage.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance the gate-to-content state change with document.startViewTransition(), while respecting reduced motion.

findings.summary: Persistent navigation does not expose scroll-state-aware behaviour.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no scroll-state query or declarative scroll-position treatment on a long listing page.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries for sticky navigation changes where they improve orientation; retain a static fallback.

findings.summary: Menus and dropdowns use custom positioning without anchor positioning or fallback positions.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains custom dropdown/combobox structures, while the CSS probe found no anchor-name, position-anchor, or position-try.
findings.suggestedFix: Use CSS anchor positioning and position-try for menus/tooltips, retaining a compatible fallback.

findings.summary: Consent and age overlays are custom div-based dialogs instead of native semantic primitives.
findings.evidence: The probe found one custom role=dialog and zero dialog, popover, or details elements; the cookie overlay also uses a custom full-screen wrapper.
findings.suggestedFix: Use <dialog> for the modal age decision and Popover where appropriate, with native focus, Escape, and light-dismiss behaviour.

findings.summary: The mobile age gate clips core content and the under-age decision.
findings.evidence: At 360×800 the screenshot cuts off explanatory text and most of the second age button even though horizontal scrolling is suppressed.
findings.suggestedFix: Reflow the gate into a single-column layout, allow text wrapping, and avoid clipping overflow at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Reusable cards and overlays rely on viewport rules rather than component-level responsiveness.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container usage despite cards, navigation, and overlays appearing in multiple widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable card/navigation/overlay components, with viewport fallbacks where needed.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus and target sizing are not consistently usable.
findings.evidence: The focused Cookie Notice link computed to outline:none and no box-shadow; the probe also listed many visible controls only 15–22 px high.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and expand interactive hit areas to at least WCAG target-size guidance without relying on hover.

findings.summary: Unknown routes silently redirect to the homepage instead of explaining the error.
findings.evidence: The deliberately invalid path resolved to https://it.pornhub.com/ with title Pornhub and no error heading or recovery message.
findings.suggestedFix: Return a real 404 with a concise explanation, search/home recovery actions, and preserved navigation context.

findings.summary: Largest Contentful Paint is far outside the good range.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 14.1 s, FCP 3.0 s, and Speed Index 5.5 s; the independent trace measured LCP 3.88 s under a different profile.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce initial document/script work, and remeasure under representative mobile conditions.

findings.summary: The mobile entry state crosses the good CLS threshold.
findings.evidence: The 360×800 layout observer measured CLS 0.1021 from a shift at about 2.95 s; three images also lack explicit dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for late content and images, and use stable font fallbacks so CLS stays at or below 0.1.

findings.summary: Initial delivery is heavy and has a long critical chain.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 170 requests and 4.31 MB transferred, including multiple VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets and High parser scripts; Lighthouse estimates 580 ms render-blocking savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce render-blocking CSS/scripts, prioritize only the LCP asset, and improve cache/dependency ordering.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 178 KiB unused JavaScript, 74 KiB unused CSS, and 54 KiB legacy JavaScript savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route/consent state, remove duplicate or legacy bundles, and load third-party code only when needed.

findings.summary: Important fields and embedded content lack complete accessible labelling.
findings.evidence: The search input has no associated label, Lighthouse flags an untitled frame, and the video-detail probe found one image without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide programmatic labels, title every iframe, and add meaningful alt text or empty alt for decorative images.

findings.summary: The homepage has weak heading structure and invisible keyboard focus.
findings.evidence: The only visible homepage heading is H3 with no H1, and a focused legal link has outline:none and no box-shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a logical H1-led hierarchy and consistent :focus-visible treatment; preserve focus when overlays close.

findings.summary: Mobile text and controls are clipped rather than reflowed.
findings.evidence: The 360 px screenshot truncates multiple lines and the second age action, forcing users to infer missing content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use fluid line lengths and wrapping, and stack actions so all gate copy remains readable at narrow sizes.

findings.summary: Reflow, touch targets, and media alternatives are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags restrictive viewport scaling, the probe finds many controls under 24 px high, and the sampled video has no caption track.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom, enlarge targets, and provide synchronized captions or an equivalent transcript for video.

findings.summary: The homepage throws an uncaught JavaScript exception.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading addEventListener) in setInstallButton at homepage line 4577.
findings.suggestedFix: Guard optional install controls before binding listeners and add regression coverage for the non-installable state.

findings.summary: Asset markup is incomplete despite valid doctype and charset.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found three images without dimensions and Lighthouse flags unsized images plus 722 KiB potential image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic width/height, responsive sources, and modern formats while preserving the valid document foundation.

findings.summary: The page triggers browser-platform hygiene failures.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports two deprecated API warnings, four BFCache failure reasons, and DevTools inspector issues.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove deprecated APIs, resolve lifecycle/BFCache blockers, and clear actionable DevTools Issues.

findings.summary: Pages use a generic title and omit a meta description.
findings.evidence: The homepage and sampled video both render title “Pornhub”; direct DOM probes found no meta description, and the video title is not reflected in <title>.
findings.suggestedFix: Give every archetype a unique descriptive title and concise meta description.

findings.summary: Crawler controls and link destinations are malformed.
findings.evidence: robots.txt redirects to the homepage HTML, producing 4,073 Lighthouse parse errors, and 18 anchors use javascript: URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a valid text/plain robots.txt and use real href URLs for navigable content.

findings.summary: Indexing signals collapse distinct pages onto the homepage.
findings.evidence: The video page declares the homepage canonical, has no hreflang, robots.txt redirects, sitemap.xml returns 404, and the direct probe observed noindex,nofollow.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-consistent canonicals/hreflang, a valid robots file and sitemap, and only use noindex when it is an explicit publishing decision.

findings.summary: The video detail lacks structured and social metadata.
findings.evidence: The sampled detail page exposes no JSON-LD and no Open Graph tags despite having a visible H1 and media entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata matching the visible page.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS, but key browser defenses and cookie attributes are missing.
findings.evidence: Headers show no CSP or nosniff; cookies include an rp cookie without Secure and all seven sampled cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff, an explicit referrer policy, and least-privilege Secure/SameSite cookie attributes.

findings.summary: A large tracking footprint loads before the user has made a consent choice.
findings.evidence: The initial load contacted 12 third-party origins and known Google Tag Manager/DoubleClick trackers; HAR attributes 99 requests and 2.06 MB to third parties while the consent overlay is still present.
findings.suggestedFix: Block non-essential analytics/advertising until consent, minimize vendors and events, and batch the remaining telemetry.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The main response lacks CSP, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy, although HSTS and X-Frame-Options are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add CSP frame-ancestors/Trusted Types where appropriate, nosniff, strict referrer policy, and least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Only a minority of rendered content is available to a non-JavaScript crawler.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured 35% rendered-word coverage in raw HTML; the gate requires scripted state changes to reach content.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core route content and keep age/consent actions functional with progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: The custom modal fails at a narrow viewport.
findings.evidence: At 360 px the age dialog clips text and the under-age action while suppressing horizontal overflow, making recovery impossible for that choice.
findings.suggestedFix: Use robust top-layer/modal layout, intrinsic sizing, and edge-aware positioning so every control remains reachable.

findings.summary: HTTP failure states are replaced by an unexplained success-looking homepage.
findings.evidence: A deliberately nonexistent URL silently redirected to the homepage with no 404 status message or retry/recovery state.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the failing URL/status and render an actionable error state with home/search options.

findings.summary: The Italian document language is correct, but layout CSS is not writing-mode resilient.
findings.evidence: The probe confirms lang=it and ltr, but finds physical left/right properties and no logical inline/block properties in accessible CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties and preserve correct lang/dir per locale.

findings.summary: Rendered numeric abbreviations do not follow Italian formatting.
findings.evidence: Italian pages display values such as 35.8K and 2.3M using an English decimal point rather than locale-aware formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Format counts, dates, and durations with Intl APIs using the active locale.

findings.summary: Image delivery wastes bytes and responsive opportunities.
findings.evidence: Thirty-three of 37 images lack srcset, 18 use legacy formats, and Lighthouse estimates 722 KiB image-delivery savings.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve AVIF/WebP where suitable, add responsive srcset/sizes, and retain lazy loading below the fold.

findings.summary: Initial work includes avoidable analytics and duplicated payloads.
findings.evidence: The page makes 170 requests, including 37 fetch/XHR calls and analytics before consent; Lighthouse reports unused code and 2.1 s main-thread work.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer and batch background analytics, eliminate redundant fetches, and conditionally load non-core code.

findings.summary: Third-party and advertising resources consume a disproportionate share of the initial load.
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 99 requests and 2.06 MB, including about 1.01 MB from TrafficJunky creatives and 302 KB from Google Tag Manager.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, delay advertising/media until needed and consented, and remove low-value vendors.
